title: Final: the camera
cards/0/task: Everything is broken: the angle is too narrow, near is too far away and far is too close. Make all three cubes visible.
cards/1/q: You set camera.fov = 75 and nothing changed. Why?
cards/1/options/2: You have to recreate the renderer
cards/1/explain: The camera caches its projection matrix.
cards/2/q: What will cut an object out of the picture? Select all that apply.
cards/2/options/2: It is outside the field of view
cards/2/explain: A dark object is still drawn, just dark.
cards/3/q: Place the camera and turn it toward the center
cards/3/explain: lookAt turns an object to face a point.
cards/4/q: Match the symptom to the cause
cards/5/q: Which camera fits an isometric game?
cards/6/q: OrbitControls with enableDamping. What must be in the loop?
cards/6/explain: Calling update every frame smoothly finishes the motion.
cards/7/task: Keep only red and green in the frame: blue is background and should not be drawn. Do not touch fov or the camera.
